elements.requirement: Section 227B of the Finance Act 1994 applies where, in accordance with the rules or practice of Lloyd's, a corporate member designated as the successor has taken up the syndicate capacity of another corporate member designated as the predecessor.
elements.quote: a corporate member (“the successor”) has taken up the syndicate capacity of another corporate member (“the predecessor”)

elements.requirement: Where section 227B of the Finance Act 1994 applies, section 343 of the Taxes Act 1988 applies as if the trade mentioned in that section were the underwriting business of the predecessor.
elements.quote: the trade mentioned in that section were the underwriting business of the predecessor

elements.requirement: Where section 227B of the Finance Act 1994 applies, section 343 of the Taxes Act 1988 applies as if the predecessor ceases to carry on the trade, and the successor begins to carry it on, at the end of the first underwriting year in which profits or losses of the predecessor's last active underwriting year are declared.
elements.quote: the predecessor ceases to carry it on, and the successor begins to carry it on, at the end of the first underwriting year in which profits or losses of the predecessor's last active underwriting year are declared

elements.requirement: Where section 227B of the Finance Act 1994 applies, section 343 of the Taxes Act 1988 applies as if subsections (8) to (10) and (12) of that section were omitted.

A successor is treated as having taken up the predecessor's syndicate capacity if the successor has taken up the rights to participate in syndicates which were, or otherwise would be, offered to the predecessor.
elements.quote: the successor has taken up the predecessor's syndicate capacity if it has taken up the rights to participate in syndicates which were (or otherwise would be) offered to the predecessor

elements.requirement: The term 'last active underwriting year' has the same meaning as provided in subsections (2) to (4) of section 227A of the Finance Act 1994.
elements.quote: “last active underwriting year” has the same meaning as in section 227A above (see subsections (2) to (4) of that section)

elements.requirement: Section 43(1) of the Finance Act 2007 takes effect in any case where the first underwriting year in which profits or losses of the predecessor's final underwriting year are declared is 2007 or a later underwriting year.
elements.quote: has effect in any case where the first underwriting year in which profits or losses of the predecessor's final underwriting year are declared is 2007 or a later underwriting year

thresholds.what: the earliest declared underwriting year of profits or losses of the predecessor's final underwriting year for the provision to have effect
thresholds.quote: declared is 2007 or a later underwriting year
